findings.reason: The authentic standalone original image contains only prose and the output formula. A two-register circuit materially clarifies that preparation A acts on the system, Hadamards/inverse QFT/measurement act on the phase register, and each controlled power couples the indicated phase bit to the system. This is a warranted explanatory addition, not a claim that the existing complete algorithm is mathematically defective.
findings.action: Added a fenced TikZ circuit in final Remarks, with explicit big-endian control indexing, full signed Q convention, and separately identified classical output processing.

correction: Appended a two-register QPE amplitude-estimation schematic and explanatory Remarks; original Definition and all frontmatter retained byte-for-byte.

diagram_math_checks.check: The phase register is (C^2)^{tensor m}; system H is nonzero finite-dimensional. A:H→H prepares ψ=A|0>. H_Had^{tensor m} and F_M^{-1} act only on the upper register; Q:H→H acts only on the system, conditionally on a phase bit. The source input contract defines A and Q and its proof 1.1 establishes Q unitary.

With big-endian x=sum_j b_{m-1-j}2^j, the left shown control q_{m-1} applies Q^1 and the right q_0 applies Q^{2^{m-1}}. Omitted j=1,…,m−2 controls are explicitly stated. Their product is Q^{sum_j b_{m-1-j}2^j}=Q^x; thus the controlled-power map on the joint space is |x>⊗v↦|x>⊗Q^xv. For m=2 the two shown powers are exactly all powers.

All drawn controlled gates use Q=-AS_0A* S_good, retaining the leading minus; no global phase is dropped. In repeated-unitary mode the input contract requires C(-I)C(A)C(S_0)C(A*)C(S_good), and the caption retains that control phase. The circuit places inverse positive-sign QFT after the controls, then computational-basis phase measurement; it introduces no controlled inverse-Q query.

Measurement produces y in 0,…,M−1. The output identity follows from ζ_M^y+ζ_M^{-y}=2 cos(2πy/M) and sin²t=(1−cos2t)/2. The figure does not equate the output with the true amplitude or assert accuracy; it locates exact cyclotomic output and decimal approximation in classical postprocessing. The original algorithm remains verbatim and its rigorous correctness argument remains independent of the figure.
